## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic completed 425 captures during June 2026. Activity was delivered through the scheduled clinic sessions, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available information indicates that imaging activity proceeded in line with the planned service arrangements for the month. No additional operational issues are recorded in the site report.

## Image quality

Of the 425 captures, 25 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.9 per cent of captures. The image-quality outcome should be considered when reviewing the overall performance of the service and identifying opportunities to support consistently usable images. The report does not provide further detail on the reasons for individual images being ungradable.

## Grading

A total of 116 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This indicates that the central grading process continued to provide results within a short timeframe during June 2026. The referable results and image-quality findings should be reviewed together as part of routine monitoring of activity, grading performance and follow-up requirements at Harbour Eye Clinic.
